S2. MATERIAL FINDING (1): the new requires-item declaration supplies a false source-semantic explanation for its Sovereign Glue sibling, and that explanation reaches the DM through lookup_rules. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.16.6 repair/integration lane (implementation responsibility .16.6.2; neither modified by this review). packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/recordRelationshipDeclarations.ts:315-322 declares the whole /mechanics/interItem/requiresItems/*/itemRefs/* shape with reason: "A magic item the printed attunement text requires the wielder to wear (Hammer of Thunderbolts: belt of giant strength, gauntlets of ogre power)." This is not solely private commentary: resolveRecordRelationships includes declaration on each resolved occurrence, ruleAwareness.ts:95-98 returns it, and toolLookupRules.ts:155-171 exposes it in the actual model-facing result. Concrete record: magic-item:sovereign-glue, /mechanics/interItem/requiresItems/0/itemRefs/0 = magic-item:oil-of-slipperiness. Actual lookup_rules({kind:"magic-item",ref:"magic-item:sovereign-glue"}) returns this link with the quoted wear/attunement reason, alongside requiresAttunement:false and state:"inside of storage container coated". The vendored SRD p.242 (independently extracted with pdftotext) identifies a storage-container coating prerequisite and has no attunement requirement. Scenario: the DM consults Sovereign Glue to answer how it must be stored; the new relationship channel mischaracterizes the oil as worn attunement equipment. This violates the owning bead's source-grounded declaration requirement and ADR 0020 section 1's faithful rule-awareness boundary. It is a reachable semantic/source-truthfulness error, not a request for universal reference coverage or hypothetical hardening. Sibling search: all three requires-item leaves in both items examined; Hammer's two wearing prerequisites fit, Glue's storage prerequisite does not. The other four new declarations and all their emitted target kinds were checked without an additional mismatch. Closure: broaden/correct this declaration's reason to truthfully encompass both storage and attunement prerequisites, regenerate record-relationships.json, and check the actual lookup output for both source-backed cases. Do not drop the valid Glue relationship. Evidence classification: exact source-backed reproducer for this prose-semantic mismatch, proportionate because resolution is already protected by generalized family tests and a resolver rewrite is unnecessary. Reproducer used: ./node_modules/.bin/tsx /tmp/eshyra-699-review.mts; its concrete inputs and contradictory output are recorded above, so this finding does not depend on retaining /tmp.
